programs.title: Food Safari
programs.desc: Food Safari revels in the clever combination of Portuguese and African cuisines that are the key to much of Brazilian cooking. Maeve teams up with two talented Brazilian cooks - Regina Kytzia from Casa Brazil Restaurant and Edna Barzel of Sweet Brazil, both of whom are passionate about their homeland and keen to show off the many ingredients used.

programs.title: The Chocolate Queen
programs.desc: Kirsten wows us with her scrumptious chocolate pecan pie, irresistible raspberry coconut chocolate slices, some creative and delicious meringue lollipops, and the best brownie you will ever make.

programs.title: Everyday Gourmet With Justine Schofield
programs.desc: Pastry Chef, Kirsten Tibballs drops in today to make her sable rose choux puff and Justine shares her recipe for baked eggplant with sweet chilli sauce.

programs.title: The Cook Up With Adam Liaw
programs.desc: Adam poses a crucial question to his guests, comedian Jay Wymarra and presenter Samantha Martin: chicken or fish? Spoiler alert: their answers are delicious.

programs.title: Jamie's Family Super Food
programs.desc: Jamie Oliver is on the Greek island of Ikaria, where he helps 84-year-old Giorgios work the land and enjoys a lunch overlooking the sea, before visiting a Costa Rican cattle ranch where he eats black beans - a superfood packed with protein and fibre. Recipes featured include sweet potato, chilli, cheese and seed muffins, carbonara with smoky bacon, peas, almonds and basil, and smoky black bean stew with squash, peppers, rice and chili salsa.

programs.title: A Taste Of Island Dreams
programs.desc: For the perfect skewers, Alimah was taught to imagine she was sewing a running stitch when threading the skewer through the meat. She shares an Island Dreams satay favourite.
